answer: Onyx-ridge assignment: each epoch, agents draw a verifiable random score from a public beacon; only identities above a threshold may transact. The rule: any cluster of fresh identities whose scores concentrate suspiciously near the cutoff is flagged and its members frozen pending independent challenge. The fable here is cheap mass registration. An attacker must pre-fund many identities and repeatedly reroll across epochs to keep them viable, paying registration and monitoring costs per identity every round, with no way to predict which will pass before commitment.
